community.title: Community
community.subtitle: Meet the other members of this app.
community.brokenTitle: The community is switched on, but the configuration does not hold
community.brokenIntro: config/community.json has problems — while they persist, the community stays invisible to members:
community.emptyDescription: Groups are created by the operator in the admin area — as soon as there are any, they appear here.
community.profileCardDescription: This is what other members see of you. Your email address and your purchases are not part of it.
community.profileDisplayNameHint: You appear under this name on everything you write. You can change it at any time.
community.profileAvatarHint: JPEG, PNG or WebP, at most {max}. Visible to signed-in members — never on the open web.
community.profileAvatarTooLarge: The picture you picked is {size}, and at most {max} gets through here. Pick a smaller one.
community.profileSavedNoPicture: Name and text saved — the picture was not.
community.profileAboutHint: A few sentences others will recognise you by. Optional.
community.groupEmptyDescription: Nothing has been written in this room yet. Start the first conversation.
community.startDiscussionDescription: Give it a title and write the first post.
community.fieldFirstPostPlaceholder: Write what you want to ask or tell.
community.editPostDescription: Others can see that you changed the post.
community.deletePostConfirm: The post disappears for everybody. A note takes its place so the replies under it still make sense. You cannot undo this.
community.state_authorDeleted: This post was deleted by the person who wrote it.
community.state_moderatorRemoved: This post was removed by moderation.
community.state_accountDeleted: This post is from a deleted account.
community.lockedBody: Nothing more can be added here. Reading still works.
community.nameFirstBody: You appear under this name on everything you write. You can read without one.
community.embedEmptyDescription: Write the first post about this section.
community.liveStoppedBody: It is not available to you here right now. Reload the page if you think that is a mistake — what you have written stays where it is.
community.messagesEmptyDescription: Open a member's profile and write to them — your conversations appear here.
community.messagePrivacyNote: Only the two of you can read this conversation.
community.messageRemoved: This message was removed by moderation.
community.blockConfirm: {name} will not be able to message you any more, and you will not be able to message them. Nothing changes in the rooms — you both still see each other's posts there. You can undo this at any time.
community.blockedNote: You have blocked this person. New messages arrive in neither direction.
community.unfollowed: You are no longer following them.
community.peopleSubtitle: Whom you follow, and who follows you.
community.followingEmptyDescription: Open a member's profile and follow them — they turn up here afterwards.
community.followedByEmptyDescription: Anyone following you appears here — visibly, always. There is no silent following.
community.followVisibleNote: Following is one-sided and immediate — and visible: whoever you follow sees you on their list.
community.feedSubtitle: The latest posts by the people you follow — from rooms you can enter.
community.feedNoFollowsDescription: Open a member's profile and follow them — what they write turns up here.
community.feedEmptyDescription: Nothing from the people you follow right now. The feed only shows rooms you can enter.
community.moderationSubtitle: What was done, by whom, and why.
community.moderationEmptyDescription: Every removal and every locked thread appears here — once the first one happens.
community.moderationOwnOnly: You see your own actions. The operator has the full list.
community.removeByModeratorConfirm: It disappears for everybody. Your reason goes into the record and into the affected person's data export — write it the way you would want it read out.
community.reportDescription: Moderation sees this post and your reason. You do not have to write anything — reporting is enough.
community.reportDmDescription: Moderation sees this message and your reason.
community.reportDmHonesty: ⚠ In a conversation between two people, the other one can work out that you reported them. We do not promise anonymity we cannot keep.
community.reported: Thank you — moderation can see it.
community.reportsSubtitle: What members reported as spam and nobody has looked at yet.
community.reportAttachHint: Pick up to {max} further messages from this conversation so moderation sees the context. Exactly those become visible and no others — and which ones is recorded.
community.reportWindowNote: Only these messages are visible — the reporter chose them, and the choice is in the record.
community.blockBannerBody: Enough reports stand against this member that they have not been able to write since {since}. They can still read everything. One tap lifts it — and handles every counted report while doing so.
community.reportConflict: You are conflicted here — somebody else takes this one.
community.blockConflict: You reported them yourself — somebody else takes this one.
community.accountExportNote: From the community: your profile, your moderator duties, the discussions you started, your posts in full, which pictures you attached to which post, and how far you have read.
community.accountDeletionNote: From the community: your profile including its picture, the pictures you attached to posts, your moderator duties and how far you have read. Your posts stay as empty placeholders so the replies under them still make sense — the text and the pictures go, the row does not. The same for the titles of the discussions you started.
community.postImageHint: JPEG, PNG or WebP, at most {max}. Location data is removed.
community.postImageTooLarge: {size} does not fit — at most {max} per picture.
community.postImageAltPlaceholder: e.g. My finished shelf, oak, three levels
community.state_autoHiddenMine: This post was reported and is being reviewed. Others cannot see it in the meantime. There is nothing for you to do.
community.blocksSubtitle: Who cannot write at the moment, and why.
community.blocksEmptyDescription: Neither automatically nor by hand. Every block appears here as soon as there is one.
community.blocksContradictionBody: These people are blocked by hand and now hold the moderator role: {names}. That can only happen if the role was granted after the block. Decide which should stand — the role comes off in the user administration, the block here.
community.blocksGraceTitle: New accounts are limited for their first hours
community.blocksGraceBody: Somebody who has just signed up and bought nothing may write {posts, plural, one {one post} other {# posts}} a day for their first {hours, plural, one {one hour} other {# hours}}, {links, plural, =0 {no links at all} one {one link per post} other {# links per post}}, and send messages at a tighter rate. It applies to nobody with purchased access, no moderator and nobody on the whitelist. It is in no table and ends by itself — so this is the rule rather than a list. Change it in config/community.json under "newMember".
community.listReasonNote: The reason goes in the trail and in the subject access report of the person concerned — write it the way you would want it read back to you.
community.list_protected_onBody: Automatic blocks and automatic post locks will no longer reach them. It grants them no extra rights.
community.list_protected_offBody: They can be silenced automatically again, like everybody else.
community.list_writeBlocked_onBody: They will not be able to write anything — they can still read everything. The block stands until you lift it here; nothing lifts it on its own.
community.list_writeBlocked_offBody: They will be able to write again.
community.list_reportsIgnored_onBody: Their reports are still written and still appear in the queue — they simply weigh nothing. They are not told; a visible refusal would be an invitation to open a second account.
community.list_reportsIgnored_offBody: Their future reports count normally again. Ones already written stay as they are.
community.listsSubtitle: Who is protected, blocked by hand, or has their reports ignored.

communityAdmin.title: Groups
communityAdmin.description: {count, plural, =0 {No groups yet} one {One group} other {# groups}} — the rooms your members meet in.
communityAdmin.createDescription: Give the room a name and decide who may enter it.
communityAdmin.fieldDescriptionPlaceholder: A sentence or two: what belongs in here?
communityAdmin.noPlans: config/digistore-products.json holds no product that can unlock anything — a token package is a balance, not an entitlement.
communityAdmin.levelHint_open: Every signed-in member of this app sees the room and may enter it.
communityAdmin.levelHint_plan: Only somebody who holds at least one of the chosen products RIGHT NOW. Re-checked on every read — a refund or an expired term closes the door by itself, and a past purchase on its own does not open it.
communityAdmin.levelHint_moderators: The moderators and you. The room where you agree on how the community is run.
communityAdmin.levelHint_operator: You alone. A room nobody else sees.
communityAdmin.archiveConfirm: “{name}” disappears for every member. Nothing is lost — every word stays, and you can bring the room back at any time. A group is never deleted.
communityAdmin.moderatorsDescription: Moderators for “{name}”. You moderate everywhere — that needs no entry.
communityAdmin.moderatorsNone: Nobody assigned — you look after the room.
communityAdmin.moderatorsNoCandidates: No account holds the “Moderator” role. Give it out under Users first.
communityAdmin.emptyBody: Create the first one. Careful: groups are rows in the database and do NOT travel with a deploy — create them where the app runs.
communityAdmin.hintRowsDoNotTravel: Groups live in this environment's database. A deploy carries code, not rows: what you create here locally does not exist in the live app.
communityAdmin.moderatorsAllAssigned: Every moderator in this app already looks after this room.

errors.communityAboutInvalid: Your about text could not be read.
errors.communityAboutTooLong: Your about text is too long — at most {max} characters.
errors.communityAlreadyDeleted: This post has already been deleted.
errors.communityConflictOfInterest: You reported them yourself — somebody else takes this one.
errors.communityDiscussionLocked: This discussion is closed — nothing more can be added to it.
errors.communityDisplayNameInvalid: The display name cannot be empty and must be at most {max} characters.
errors.communityGroupDescriptionInvalid: The description could not be read.
errors.communityGroupDescriptionTooLong: The description is too long — at most {max} characters.
errors.communityGroupNameInvalid: The group needs a name of at most {max} characters, and it cannot be blank. Invisible characters and characters that reverse the text direction are not allowed.
errors.communityMessageEmpty: Write something — an empty message says nothing.
errors.communityMessageRateLimited: That was a lot of messages in a short time. Wait a few minutes.
errors.communityMessageTooLong: That is too long — at most {max} characters.
errors.communityNotDeliverable: This message could not be delivered.
errors.communityNotEntitled: This discussion is not available here.
errors.communityNotModerator: Only members holding the “Moderator” role can look after a group. Change their role under Users first.
errors.communityOff: The community is not active on this installation.
errors.communityPlanKeysRequired: A plan-gated group needs at least one product — otherwise it is a door with no key.
errors.communityPostEmpty: Write something — an empty post helps nobody.
errors.communityPostRateLimited: That was a lot of posts in a short time. Wait a few minutes.
errors.communityPostTooLong: That is too long — at most {max} characters.
errors.communityProfileIncomplete: Choose a name for the community first — you appear under it on everything you write.
errors.communityReportRateLimited: That was a lot of reports in a short time. Wait a few minutes.
errors.communitySendBlocked: You cannot write at the moment — there are reports against you. Moderation can lift this. You can still read everything.
errors.communityTitleInvalid: Give the discussion a title of at most {max} characters.
errors.communityUnknownPlanKey: This app cannot unlock the product key “{key}” — it is not in config/digistore-products.json, or it is a token package. A token package is a balance, not an entitlement: nobody would ever get into this group.
errors.communityTooManyImages: That is too many pictures — at most {max} per post.
errors.communityImageAltInvalid: Say what each picture shows, in at most {max} characters. Somebody reading with a screen reader has nothing else to go on.
errors.communityImagesOff: Posts in this community do not take pictures.
errors.communityWriteBlocked: You cannot write here at the moment — moderation decided that. You can still read everything.
errors.communityCannotListRole: Operators and moderators cannot go on this list. Take the role away first.
errors.communityStandingConflict: Protected and blocked at the same time is not a state. Choose one.
errors.communityNewMemberPostLimit: That is it for today — a new account can write {max, plural, one {one post} other {# posts}} a day. {hours, plural, one {In an hour} other {In # hours}} this limit is gone.
errors.communityNewMemberNoLinks: New accounts cannot post links yet. {hours, plural, one {In an hour} other {In # hours}} you can; until then, write the address out in words.
